title: 🧩 HOME SCREEN WIDGETS ARE HERE!
message: Stay disciplined without even opening the app! Put your tasks, trackers and dots right on your home screen and update them with a single tap. ⚒️🔥
points: 📅 Daily Tasks Widget: See all of today's tasks, tick them done with one tap and earn your DP right from the home screen.
◀️▶️ Change the Date: Use the arrows on the widget to look at past or upcoming days, and tap the date to jump back to today.
➕ Quick Add: Tap the + on the widget to create a new task or daily habit in seconds, without opening the app.
🛡️ Proof in One Tap: Tap 'PROOF' on any completed task or protocol to jump straight to adding your photos, notes or voice proof.
🎯 Tracker Widget: Your full tracker card with the − and + buttons and the progress ring. Log water, pages, steps and more instantly.
🔵 Dots Widget: Your protocol card with the full month of dots. Tap any day to secure it, and use ‹ › and TODAY to move between months.
🧩 Add Many Widgets: Place one widget for each tracker or protocol, so every goal gets its own spot on your home screen.
📲 One-Tap Add: Tap the widget icon on the Home screen, or choose 'Add to Home Screen' from any tracker or protocol menu.
📐 Smooth Resizing: Make any widget bigger or smaller and everything scales evenly to fit perfectly.
🔒 Same Rules, Same Progress: Everything you do on a widget instantly syncs with the app, and your Premium limits stay the same.

title: 🎙️ VOICE PROOF IS HERE!
message: Now you can speak your proof of work! Record voice clips to capture your wins, struggles and progress in your own words. ⚒️🔥
points: 🎙️ Record Voice Proof: Tap 'Tap to Record Voice' when adding proof for any task, tracker or challenge, then tap again to stop.
➕ Multiple Clips: Add as many voice clips as you want to a single proof, up to 3 minutes each.
▶️ Easy Playback: Tap the orange mic badge on your task cards and timelines to listen to your recordings anytime.
🗑️ Remove Anytime: Delete any clip you don't need with one tap before saving.
🔒 100% Private: Your voice recordings stay only on your device and are never uploaded.
📜 Smoother Proof Screen: The proof screen now scrolls nicely even when you add lots of photos and voice clips.

title: ⚡ FOCUS TASKS, FIELD NOTES & DAILY CHECKLIST FIXES!
message: We have upgraded your Battle Timer with built-in to-do checklists and personal notes, made it easier to extend your focus sessions, and fixed daily subtask resets! ⚒️🔥
points: 📝 In-Timer Tasks & Notes: Tap your active task or the TASKS button in the timer to instantly view your to-do items, jot down thoughts, and log notes while you focus.
⏱️ Quick Time Extension: Easily increase your target time directly inside the timer circle whenever you need to stretch your session further.
🔄 Automatic Subtask Reset Fix: Daily habit checklists now reset properly every morning so you can start fresh every day without manual unchecking.
🛡️ Structured 30-Min Focus Blocks: Free sessions are optimized for focused 30-minute intervals to maximize concentration and avoid burnout.
🎯 Zen & Lockdown Enhancements: Smoother device rotation handling and cleaner active task indicators in full-screen focus modes.

title: ⚡ SMOOTHER TASK CREATION & CALENDAR TIMELINE JUMP!
message: We have smoothed out task setup from AI chat, added instant calendar jumping from your history logs, and improved calendar navigation across your journey! ⚒️🔥
points: 🛠️ Fixed AI Task Creation: The 'Review & Create' button now works seamlessly when creating Tasks, Habits, Trackers, and Timeline targets directly from AI chat.
📅 Tap-to-Jump Date History: Tap any past task in your Chronological History to immediately jump your main calendar right to that exact day.
🗓️ Centered Month & Year Display: Easily see which month and year you are browsing directly below your daily calendar dates.
💎 Reduced Premium Rates: We have lowered subscription pricing so you can unlock unlimited protocols, offline AI, and an ad-free experience for less.
🚀 Performance & Stability Fixes: Smoother screen animations, faster layout transitions, and overall stability improvements.

title: 🏆 5 NEW ELITE RANKS & COMPACT DP DISPLAY!
message: The Forge mainframe has expanded its boundaries. Scale new heights beyond Titan rank all the way to 1,000,000 DP, enjoy cleaner compact point displays, and experience faster performance! ⚒️🔥
points: 🏆 5 New Elite Ranks: Break through the 60K DP limit! Unlock Warlord (100K), Overlord (250K), Immortal (500K), Mythic (750K), and Conqueror (1M).
📊 Sleek Compact DP Scores: Discipline Points now display in clean K and M formats (e.g., 1.2K, 100K, 1.1M) to save space and look cleaner.
🌐 Direct DevDuo Store Link: Explore our full suite of apps easily with the new direct Store button in the DevDuo ecosystem hub.
🛡️ Tightened System Capacities: Free tier limits refined to 3 active Habits, Trackers, Protocols, and Targets to enforce laser-sharp focus.
⚡ System Optimizations: Smoother screen transitions, faster database loading, and tighter AI action checks for an unshakeable experience.

title: 🌐 DEVDUO SOFTWARE ECOSYSTEM & UI ENHANCEMENTS!
message: Explore the full DevDuo Software suite directly inside the Forge! Discover our growing collection of productivity apps and tools built for work, play, and focus. ⚒️🔥
points: 🌐 DevDuo Ecosystem Hub: Access the newly added More Apps screen to browse our full software catalog with direct store links and feature previews.
🎨 Tactical Promo Integration: Sleek, high-fidelity promotional cards integrated across the Stats matrix and Remote Update views.
🚀 Fluid Navigation Flow: Optimized route handling and smooth transitions when exploring ecosystem apps and returning to the Forge.
🛡️ Network Uplink Hardening: Reinforced connection checks and graceful error-handling fallbacks for seamless offline/online operations.

title: ⚡ ELITE SPEED CORE & UX REFINEMENTS!
message: The Forge is running at maximum velocity! Experience faster load times, optimized background engine handling, and sleek UI/UX enhancements across all tabs. ⚒️🔥
points: ⚡ High-Velocity Compute: Re-engineered internal execution logic and background rendering routines to drastically reduce app latency.
🎨 UI Style Polishing: Enhanced container structural layouts, tracking rings, and layout padding for a cleaner dark-mode design.
🚀 Rapid Tab Switching: Swiping or navigating between Today, Tracker, Dots, and Timeline elements now responds instantly with zero stutter.
🔧 Mainframe Hardening: Patched subtle background memory issues and reinforced state loading frameworks to guarantee flawless operational stability.

title: 🆕 INFINITE CALENDAR & LAUNCH TOGGLE ACTIVE!
message: Limits removed! Explore an infinite history calendar with zero lag, use the new toggle to skip the opening video, and enjoy a faster, smoother experience across the app. ⚒️🔥
points: 📅 Infinite Calendar for Everyone: Scroll as far back into your history or ahead into the future as you want. Fully unlocked for all users!
⚡ Stutter-Free Navigation: Tapping a date card now switches your view instantly without making the calendar bar shift or jump around.
🚀 Intro Video Toggle: Turn off the launch video using the new 'Intro Cinematic' switch in the Stats tab to open the app instantly.
↩️ Quick Return Button: Added a simple, right-docked shortcut button to automatically snap your calendar view back to Today.
🔧 Stability Hardening: Fixed an issue where the ad recovery popup would display incorrectly, ensuring smoother reward processing.

title: 🌌 MULTI-CORE AI OVERHAUL ACTIVE!
message: Shuttered limits. The Forge AI ecosystem now supports hot-swapping multiple localized compute engines on the fly. Awaken the precise level of offline intelligence your device demands! ⚒️🔥
points: ⚡ Expanded Multi-Core Matrix: Download and manage specialized High Power, Standard, or Lite AI models natively.
🔄 Instant Hot-Swapping: Swap active intelligence engines dynamically in chat without restarting the application.
📡 Link Stabilization Panel: Added a stable network banner framework with custom bug reporting integration.
🖼️ Aspect Ratio Correction: Re-engineered preview poster canvases to scale custom verification photos perfectly.
🛡️ Hardened System Security: Optimized task calibration parameters and fortified background asset logic streams.

title: 🧠 NEURAL CORE AI HAS AWAKENED!
message: The Forge has evolved. Introducing Neural Core AI—your private, on-device tactical intelligence. Forge your path with the power of localized AI and master your discipline like never before. ⚒️🔥
points: 🤖 On-Device AI: Chat with your personal discipline mentor—100% private and offline.
⚡ AI Task Generation: Create Habits, Trackers, and DOT protocols entirely through chat.
🎯 Tactical Commands: Instantly set Timeline Targets and Focus Timers using AI insights.
🛡️ Privacy Absolute: Your AI conversations are processed locally and never touch the cloud.
🚀 Engine Overhaul: Massive performance boosts and refined UI for the v4.0.0 era.

title: ⚒️ THE FORGE POSTERS ARE HERE!
message: Your discipline deserves more than just a log—it deserves a spotlight. 🔥 Turn your daily grind into premium, shareable art and showcase your journey to the world. 🖼️💪
points: 🎨 Dynamic Achievement Posters: Create stunning, Instagram-ready 4:5 posters for every win.
📈 Full Timeline Snapshots: Share your entire tracker or challenge journey in one epic visual.
✨ Premium Aesthetic Overhaul: A complete redesign of the sharing experience for maximum impact.
🛡️ Proof of Work Spotlight: Your notes and images, now formatted in professional, high-end layouts.
🚀 Optimized Performance: Smoother transitions and refined UI across the Forge.
